videos.desc: At an outdoor dinner table at dusk a young woman in a bright patterned dress pours orange juice from a glass jug into tall glasses while older relatives sit around the loaded table, laughing and clapping; she finally lifts the jug high over her head and pours a long stream into a glass.

Heavy rain on a city street. A frail elderly man in a dark jacket stands soaked, clutching a paper bag with two baguettes in it. A young person in a black raincoat steps in behind him and holds a big yellow umbrella over his head, taking all the rain themselves, then puts an arm around his shoulders. Water pours off the umbrella. The two walk on together under it and the old man smiles.

Two men on a wooden jetty on a still lake at dusk. A bearded man in a bucket hat fights a deeply bent fishing rod, winding the reel hard, sure he has a big fish. His friend sprints up the jetty with a landing net ready. What breaks the surface and swings up onto the planks is a green rubber boot full of water and weed. Both men stop dead and stare at it, the friend lowering the useless net.

A kitchen. A young man in a grey T-shirt sits at a counter and shovels a slice of strawberry cream cake into his mouth with a fork, cream smeared on his lips. A young woman in a purple cardigan appears in the doorway behind him and stands with her arms folded, staring at him. He freezes mid-bite, looks at her wide-eyed, pushes the plate away and finally hangs his head and hides his mouth behind his hand.

A young woman sits in a warm living room strung with fairy lights, crying and rubbing the back of her neck. A friend drapes a thick knitted blanket over her shoulders, others lean in, hold her hands and put their arms around her. By the end the whole group is lying together under blankets on the sofa, quiet, still and smiling.

A young woman in a denim jacket and jeans springs up out of her seat in a packed football stadium, her face lit up, and cheers. She throws both arms above her head and claps hard while the fans around her get to their feet as well. The shot then widens: first the whole stand is up, then the full stadium under the floodlights at dusk.

A young woman works late at a cluttered desk under a single angled lamp, a pencil clamped in her teeth, typing on a laptop half-buried in loose paper. Behind her the wall is papered with sticky notes and printouts, a tottering stack of documents rises beside the screen and her phone lies face-up on the table. She reads a sheet, then both hands fly to her head - she grips her hair, screws her face up and screams at the screen, then collapses forward with her head in her hands over the keyboard.

An extreme close-up of an eye with a tear welling up and rolling down the cheek. The shot widens to two friends lying together on a sofa at night under a thick knitted blanket, both crying, faces screwed up. One pulls tissues from a box on the blanket and hands one over; they dab their eyes and blow their noses, then lean their heads together and keep watching, still in tears.

A reflection in a tall gilded mirror in an elegant room with a crystal chandelier, a marble fireplace, white flowers and an open wardrobe full of clothes. A young woman with long dark hair, in a white blouse tied at the waist and a black mini skirt, takes a mirror selfie with her phone, eyes half closed, touching her hair and ignoring everyone. Behind her a young man in a light blue shirt struggles past with a wobbling stack of boxes while a white poodle on a red lead walks around him.

A selfie view on a street of old wooden houses in warm evening light. A young woman with her hair tied up, in a light blue hoodie and big hoop earrings, looks into the camera with a guilty grimace, biting her lip, and the grimace grows. Behind her a cream scooter lies on its side and a basket of yellow mangoes has spilled across the pavement. In an open doorway a young man in a white shirt and dark trousers holds his head, then puts his hands on his hips. She waves a hand towards the mess. A small golden shrine stands on the left.

On a rooftop terrace in warm evening sun, with olive trees in planters, wooden benches and red brick rooftops behind, a young woman in a blue satin slip dress and white trainers lifts a laughing friend in a cream top and wide trousers off the ground and swings her round in a hug. She sets her friend down, and they keep hugging and laughing. In front, seated friends clap, and one pours iced coffee from a glass jug into cups on a low table.

In a tall mirror in an attic bedroom, a young woman in a long burgundy wool coat, cream top and black trousers holds up a phone with keys in her other hand and stares at it with a flat, fed-up face. Behind her a young man wrapped in a white towel kneels at a pink chest of drawers, digging through clothes and pulling out a shirt, while more clothes lie in a heap on the wooden floor. A grey dog stands on the white bed. The room has dark wooden walls, beams, a candle chandelier and a window onto a harbour.

At a picnic in the desert at sunset, a young woman with long curly dark hair, in a rust shirt tied at the waist and white linen trousers, sits on a woven blanket on the sand, frowning and waving her hand at a small fly buzzing around her face while she holds a sandwich in her other hand. She shuts her eyes, blows at the fly, then turns and complains with an annoyed face as it flies off. A steel flask and a bowl of dates sit on the blanket, with sand dunes and a golden sky behind.

In a traditional Chinese garden pavilion, a young woman in a lilac satin wrap top and cream trousers suddenly bursts out laughing, covers her mouth with her hand, laughs harder with her head thrown back and finally bends over wiping her eyes. Behind her a young man in a black traditional jacket kneels very seriously at a low rosewood table, pouring tea from a small clay teapot into white cups, while a mallard duck stands on the table beside him. A red lantern and a round moon gate with bamboo are behind them.

At a sunny outdoor flea market, a young woman with long braids, in a brown t-shirt and jeans, holds up an ugly shiny green-gold china poodle holding a bunch of plastic grapes and pulls a disgusted face. She turns to look at it, grimaces again and then bursts out laughing. Beside her a young woman with red hair holds a lamp with a pink fringed shade, and an older man in a flat cap smiles behind the stall. The table is covered in teacups, brass ornaments and records under striped awnings and bunting.

Inside a car wash, a young man in a white linen shirt sits calmly in an open-top black convertible while a huge spinning blue brush presses against his head and pink soap foam covers his shirt, his shorts and the seats. The brush moves away, he closes his eyes and sips from a foamy takeaway cup, and then a jet of water sprays straight into his face. A small dog in a yellow raincoat sits in the back seat. Behind a window two women stare at him in disbelief, holding their heads.

A park path in spring with pink cherry blossom trees. A young woman with long wavy hair in a denim jacket, pink sweater and white skirt kneels on the petal-covered path with her arms wide open as a fluffy cream puppy leaps through the air towards her. She catches it, hugs it close and laughs while the puppy licks her face. A young woman in an olive jacket and cream trousers holding the lead smiles behind her, and a cyclist in a red jacket rides past. A green bench, a lamp post and daffodils are nearby.

A snowy city street at night with orange streetlights, falling snow and a red double-decker bus in the distance. A young woman in a red puffer jacket, white top and black trousers sits in the deep snow on the pavement, laughing, then lies back and makes a snow angel with her arms and legs. Another young woman in a navy hooded parka and black boots sits on the bench inside a glass bus shelter with her arms crossed and a cold, annoyed frown. Bicycles stand locked behind them.

A living room at night with rain on the window. A young woman with soaking wet hair, in a wet rust coat, dark skirt and black high heels, lies collapsed face down over a green velvet sofa, her arms hanging onto the rug and her legs up on the cushions. Her tote bag lies dropped on the floor. A black cat leaps off the sofa and walks away. A young man in a navy hoodie sits on a chair holding a mug, stares at her, then gets up, leans over and pats her on the back with a smile.

A small kitchen at night with orange patterned tiles, a glowing pendant lamp and snow outside the window. A young woman with her hair in a bun, in a lilac jumper, sits at a wooden table with an open pizza box. The young man opposite, seen only by his green sleeves and hand, reaches towards the last slice. She pulls the box away, closes it, hugs it to her chest and glares hard at him, then points at him. A grey cat sits on the counter behind her, and glasses of water and napkins lie on the table.

A rooftop deck at sunset above a busy city. A young woman with long dark hair, in a sage green top and leggings, stands barefoot on one leg in a yoga pose on a mint mat, arms raised high, smiling peacefully with her eyes half closed. She slowly brings her palms together above her head and opens her eyes, still calm. Behind and below her a motorway is completely jammed with cars and lorries, their red brake lights glowing, under tall tower blocks and an orange sky.

A sitting room in a converted church with a stained glass window, a green sofa and pastel balloons. A man in a blue shirt and cream trousers sits on a floor cushion holding a beagle puppy that licks his chin. Tears fill his eyes and his lips tremble, then he pulls the puppy close and cries openly. Beside him a smiling young woman in a red jumper kneels next to an open wicker basket and watches, and confetti drifts through the air.
